source.disclosure: Real result: teams, date, tournament, venue, final score, goalscorers, goal minutes, penalties and assists come from the CC0 international results dataset. Everything else (passes, shots, positions, substitutions, shape changes) is synthetic, generated by the Regista engine and constrained to reproduce the real goals exactly. Squads use players recorded as scoring or assisting for that country around the match date; unknown players are shown by shirt number.
